data-index="0"><button class="accordion__title body-sans-1 text-medium  text-dark" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion--content-0" data-page-track="true" data-page-track-value="prisma-browser:partner-accordion:faq:0:What is Prisma Browser?">
                    What is Prisma Browser?
                  </button><div class="accordion__content mt-2 is-active " id="accordion--content-0"><div class="body-sans-3 text-dark">Prisma Browser is an enterprise browser natively integrated with Palo Alto Networks security engines to provide organizations best in class security. It provides a secure workspace that stops evasive threats, controls AI and agents, and safely enables work for any user, in any application, in any location and from any device. 
<br /><br />
Prisma Browser is available as a dedicated enterprise browser for desktop environments, a browser extension to secure existing consumer browsers, and a mobile application.</div></div></div><div class="accordion__item " data-index="1"><button class="accordion__title body-sans-1 text-medium  text-dark" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion--content-1" data-page-track="true" data-page-track-value="prisma-browser:partner-accordion:faq:1:How does it differ from a standard consumer browser?">
                    How does it differ from a standard consumer browser?
                  </button><div class="accordion__content mt-2  " id="accordion--content-1"><div class="body-sans-3 text-dark">Unlike consumer browsers, Prisma Browser features built-in, enterprise-grade security including Advanced WildFire advanced  malware protection, native enterprise DLP, and identity controls. It prevents data leakage and blocks evasive threats that standard browsers and legacy security tools miss. <br />
Prisma Browser Extension can be deployed on consumer browsers to significantly enhance visibility, control and security on these browsers. However, secure extensions are not recommended for unmanaged devices.</div></div></div><div class="accordion__item " data-index="2"><button class="accordion__title body-sans-1 text-medium  text-dark" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion--content-2" data-page-track="true" data-page-track-value="prisma-browser:partner-accordion:faq:2:Does it replace the need for VDI or shipping laptops?">
                    Does it replace the need for VDI or shipping laptops?
                  </button><div class="accordion__content mt-2  " id="accordion--content-2"><div class="body-sans-3 text-dark">Yes. Prisma Browser serves as a high-performance alternative to VDI and DaaS, reducing total cost of ownership (TCO) by up to 80%. It allows organizations to securely onboard contractors and hybrid employees in minutes without the complexity of managing physical hardware.</div></div></div><div class="accordion__item " data-index="3"><button class="accordion__title body-sans-1 text-medium  text-dark" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion--content-3" data-page-track="true" data-page-track-value="prisma-browser:partner-accordion:faq:3:How does Prisma Browser protect against GenAI risks?">
                    How does Prisma Browser protect against GenAI risks?
                  </button><div class="accordion__content mt-2  " id="accordion--content-3"><div class="body-sans-3 text-dark">It provides full visibility and last-mile data protection for GenAI tools like ChatGPT. The browser can automatically redact sensitive data in prompts before they leave the enterprise environment, block malicious extensions, and restrict actions like copy-pasting or file uploads to unsanctioned AI apps.</div></div></div><div class="accordion__item " data-index="4"><button class="accordion__title body-sans-1 text-medium  text-dark" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion--content-4" data-page-track="true" data-page-track-value="prisma-browser:partner-accordion:faq:4:Can it secure unmanaged or BYOD devices?">
                    Can it secure unmanaged or BYOD devices?
                  </button><div class="accordion__content mt-2  " id="accordion--content-4"><div class="body-sans-3 text-dark">Absolutely. Prisma Browser isolates corporate work from the underlying untrusted endpoint and unlike extension solutions it cannot be easily bypassed. It can be deployed via a simple email link without requiring admin privileges, instantly extending Zero Trust security to personal devices.</div></div></div><div class="accordion__item  hidden " data-index="5"><button class="accordion__title body-sans-1 text-medium  text-dark" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion--content-5" data-page-track="true" data-page-track-value="prisma-browser:partner-accordion:faq:5:What makes its threat detection superior?" hidden>
                    What makes its threat detection superior?
                  </button><div class="accordion__content mt-2   hidden " id="accordion--content-5"><div class="body-sans-3 text-dark">Prisma Browser leverages Palo Alto Networks security engines that identify and block up to 8.95 million new and unique threats daily. It utilizes live web page scanning to stop zero-days and AI-powered spear phishing attacks, advanced extension security to identify and block malicious extensions and advanced browser protection to block threats hiding in the browser.</div></div></div><div class="accordion__item  hidden " data-index="6"><button class="accordion__title body-sans-1 text-medium  text-dark" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion--content-6" data-page-track="true" data-page-track-value="prisma-browser:partner-accordion:faq:6:How does it handle encrypted web traffic?" hidden>
                    How does it handle encrypted web traffic?
                  </button><div class="accordion__content mt-2   hidden " id="accordion--content-6"><div class="body-sans-3 text-dark">Prisma Browser secures 100% of web traffic, including encrypted channels, without the need for traditional decryption.                 $("#usa_list").show();

            var formInstances = $('.modalForm');

            $(btn).off("click");

                ev.stopPropagation();
                $('#pan_prisma_cloud_form_modal').modal({});

                        console.log(e);

                formInstances.validate(validationConfig.validationConfig); //

                    if (!$(".contentTrackModal").length) {
                        $('#pan_prisma_cloud_form_modal').modal('hide');

                    }
                }
            });

            return true; // Indicates success
        }
        return false; // Button not found yet

    if (document.getElementById(triggerId)) {

            subtree: true

    });

function updateEmailMask(form) {
    let email = form.find("input[name='Email']").val();
    if (email && email.trim() != '') {
        let maskedEmail = maskEmailAddress(email);
        form.find("input[name='emailFormMask']").val(maskedEmail);
    }
}

function maskEmailAddress (emailAddress) {
    function mask(str) {
        var strLen = str.length;
        if (strLen > 4) return str.substr(0, 1) + str.substr(1, strLen - 1).replace(/\w/g, '*') + str.substr(-1,1);
        return str.replace(/\w/g, '*');
    }
    return emailAddress.replace(/([\w.]+)@([\w.]+)(\.[\w.]+)/g, function (m, p1, p2, p3) { return mask(p1) + '@' + mask(p2) + p3; });
}

function tldValidator(fieldName, msg, targetForm) {
    var $currentForm = $(targetForm);
    const inputField = $currentForm.find('input[name="' + fieldName + '"]');
    const labelId = inputField.attr('id');
    
    if (inputField.next(`label[id=${labelId}-error]`).length) {
        inputField.next(`label[id=${labelId}-error]`).show().html(msg);
    } else {
        const errMsg = `<label id="${labelId}-error" class="error" for="${labelId}">${msg}</label>`;
        inputField.addClass('error').after(errMsg);
    }
    inputField.focus();
}

const showErrorMsg = (targetForm) => {
    const errorMessage = Granite.I18n.get("formError.basicUnsuccessful");
    var $currentForm = $(targetForm);
    if ($currentForm.find(".errorMsg").length) {
        $currentForm.find(".errorMsg").html(errorMessage).show();
    }
}

function formSubmit(data, targetForm){
    var $targetFormJquery = $(targetForm);
    $targetFormJquery.find('input[name="g-recaptcha-response"], input[name="action"]').remove();

    let captchaParams = data ? `&g-recaptcha-response=${data.token}&action=${data.action}` : '';

    $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: mktoConfig.mktoFormSubmitURL,
        data: $targetFormJquery.serialize() + captchaParams,
        dataType: 'json',
        success: function(data) {
            hideBtnLoader();
            if (data.success) {
                var webData = window.webData = window.webData || {};
                if (data && data.leadId) webData.marketoLeadId = data.leadId;
                webData.formEvent = "form-complete";

                try { webData.formName = $targetFormJquery.find("input[name='FormName']").val() || "No Value Found"; }
                catch (e) { webData.formName = "Form Name Extraction Error"; }

                if($(".contentTrack-layout").length > 0){
                    const isFormHidden = targetForm.getAttribute('data-hidden-lead') === 'false';
                    if(targetForm && isFormHidden && typeof _satellite !== "undefined" && _satellite){
                        _satellite.track('aemFormSubmit');
                    }
                } else if (typeof _satellite !== "undefined" && _satellite) {
                    _satellite.track('aemFormSubmit');
                }

                if(!$(".contentTrackModal").length){
                    $('#pan_prisma_cloud_form_modal_2').modal('hide');
                    $('#pan_prisma_cloud_reward_modal_2').modal({});
                    $("a[href='#free_analysis_modal']").off('click').on('click', function(ev) {
                        ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); $('#pan_prisma_cloud_reward_modal_2').modal({});
                    });
                } else {
                    // ... Content Track success logic goes here ...
                }
            } else {
                $targetFormJquery.find("button[type='submit']").prop('disabled', false);
                if (data.statuscode === 400 && typeof data.fieldname !== 'undefined' && data.fieldname !== '') {
                    if (data.fieldname == 'FirstName') tldValidator(data.fieldname, Granite.I18n.get("formError.firstNameValid"), targetForm);
                    else if(data.fieldname == 'LastName') tldValidator(data.fieldname, Granite.I18n.get("formError.lastNameValid"), targetForm);
                    else if(data.fieldname == 'Email') tldValidator(data.fieldname, Granite.I18n.get("form.error.email.domain"), targetForm);
                    else tldValidator(data.fieldname, Granite.I18n.get(data.statusmessage), targetForm);
                } else {
                   showErrorMsg(targetForm);
                }   
            }
        },
        error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
            hideBtnLoader();
            $targetFormJquery.find("button[type='submit']").prop('disabled', false);
            showErrorMsg(targetForm);
        }
    });
}

});
